fieldValues.title: Shape the work: a good issue
fieldValues.purpose: A remedy becomes issues that anyone can pick up: grounded in a problem (a bug needs none), placed under its parent, small, planned and checkable.
fieldValues.in_scope: The issue's shape (Answers, Part of, Remedy, Ruling, plan, acceptance), labels for kind and effort, sequences.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: Who picks it up (Allocate) and how it is built (Build).
